# Lago API

> Scoped machine-readable index for Lago's REST API. Use the complete OpenAPI specification for exhaustive request and response shapes.

- [API introduction](/api-reference/intro.md)
- [Authentication](/auth.md)
- [Same-origin OpenAPI discovery schema](/openapi.json)
- [Complete OpenAPI specification](https://swagger.getlago.com/openapi.yaml)
- [API standards](/api-reference/api-standards.md)
- [Structured errors](/api-reference/errors.md)
- [Rate limits](/api-reference/rate-limits.md)
- [Versioning and deprecation](/api-reference/versioning.md)
- [Developer resources](/developers.md)

Use Lago Cloud's documented regional base URL. Authenticate with a Lago API key, request only the real resource permissions needed, preserve idempotency identifiers for event ingestion, and verify the target organization before any mutation.
